configuration_patch.revision: active_revision or null on first save; stale revision 409

task_configuration: In-flight attempts retain original durable snapshot/target. Failed/terminal/uncertain attempts release secrets after processing stops, with durable release compensation until broker acknowledgement; queries do not pin them again. Deliberate retry is a new attempt using current config, advertised in UI, without historical rebind confirmations.
retention: No audio download/playback. Success/rejection clean audio; failed/interrupted idle audio expires within 24 hours; process restart cleans expired data before new acceptance. Sent clears temporary transcript/content.
